info.title: Freya Bank statement-debt services (team mock)
info.description: Mock of the bank's IVR statement services, served from test-environment data. The service does not enforce the call flow; following the bank's rules is the agent's job.

post.summary: List the customer's credit cards (cardNumber masked, cardNumberLast4, productName, status, isMainCard), validCardsCount and exitState.

customerNo.description: The 8-digit customer number from the call variable customerNumber. Never ask the caller for it.

200.description: data.cards[], data.validCardsCount, data.exitState. Envelope: {data:{...}, result:{returnCode, code, message, type}}. returnCode '1' = success.

404.description: Not found (no valid card / unknown customer). result.code e.g. FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102, result.message holds the text.

500.description: Technical error. Nothing was done. Hand the caller to an agent.

post.summary: Statement debt of one card: statementDate, lastPayDate, nextStatementDate, nextLastPayDate and per currency debtTL/debtUSD/debtEUR/debtGBP {statementPaymentStatus, statementDebt, minPayment, remainingDebt, remainingMinPayment, totalDebt, ...}.

customerNo.description: The 8-digit customer number from the call variable customerNumber. Never ask the caller for it.

cardNumber.description: The card's cardNumber exactly as returned by cards.list (masked).

200.description: data.* as described. Envelope: {data:{...}, result:{returnCode, code, message, type}}. returnCode '1' = success.

404.description: Not found (no valid card / unknown customer). result.code e.g. FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102, result.message holds the text.

500.description: Technical error. Nothing was done. Hand the caller to an agent.
